notes: QBR Pack's historical trend section now shows both a 30-day and a 90-day view side by side (previously only 90 days) -- critical/high risk delta, open case delta, efficiency ratio delta, Feature Adoption Score delta, and ONTAP upgrades, each computed independently per window against that system's closest snapshot. Either window renders its own 'not enough history yet' message if snapshot data doesn't reach back that far, rather than only gating on the longer 90-day window.
